title: First Citizens Bank’s Hope Holding Bryant and Perry Bailey Named to American Banker's 2026 Most Powerful Women in Banking Lists

body_markdown:
- ***Hope Holding Bryant*** *, Vice Chairwoman, named to the Most Powerful Women in Banking ranking for the third time*
- ***Perry Bailey*** *, Regional Executive Vice President, named to Most Powerful Women in Banking NEXT list, honoring rising industry leaders*


**RALEIGH, N.C., Oct. 1, 2026** – First Citizens Bank today announced that Hope Holding Bryant has been named to American Banker’s 2026 The Most Powerful Women in Banking™ list, and Perry Bailey has been named to the 2026 Banking NEXT™ list. Now in its 24th year, the program recognizes women whose leadership, performance, and impact are transforming the banking sector and shaping the future of financial services.


[Hope Holding Bryant](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/2026-the-most-powerful-women-in-banking-8-hope-holding-bryant-first-citizens-bank) **, Vice Chairwoman**


In addition to her role as Vice Chairwoman, Hope Holding Bryant leads the General Bank, which includes the nationwide branch network, First Citizens Wealth, and a range of specialty lines including SBA lending, a nationally recognized wine division, cannabis banking and more. She oversees approximately 6,000 associates, and the General Bank’s deposits represent nearly half of the bank’s overall deposits.


[Perry Bailey](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/2026-the-most-powerful-women-in-banking-next-perry-bailey-first-citizens-bank) **, Regional Executive Vice President, Community Region**


Perry Bailey leads business and retail banking for the Community Region, which includes branches across West Virginia, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia. She oversees business development, credit administration, operations, and regional strategy. Since joining the bank in 2016, she has held roles in the branch network and led Premier Client Services, a remote banking group serving clients across the bank's footprint.


"I want to congratulate Hope, Perry, and their respective teams on these well-earned recognitions," said Frank Holding, Chairman and CEO of First Citizens Bank. "Their commitment to serving clients, building relationships, and supporting communities has been a driving force behind our growth and success. Their leadership and dedication demonstrate the very best of First Citizens and our relationship-based approach to banking."


**About American Banker**
American Banker is the trusted source that senior executives rely on to lead through change. Through independent journalism, expert analysis, proprietary research, and benchmarking, American Banker delivers the insight financial leaders need to navigate critical opportunities and risks — AI and technology innovation, policy and regulation, M&A, and risk and resilience. American Banker connects a financial services community of more than 950,000 professionals both in person and online. Learn more at americanbanker.com.


**About First Citizens Bank**
First Citizens Bank helps personal, business, commercial and wealth clients build financial strength that lasts. Headquartered in Raleigh, N.C., First Citizens has built a unique legacy of strength, stability and long-term thinking that has spanned generations. First Citizens offers an array of general banking services with branches and offices nationwide; commercial banking expertise delivering best-in-class lending, leasing and other financial services coast to coast; innovation banking serving businesses at every stage; and a nationwide direct bank. Parent company First Citizens BancShares, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCNCA) is a top 20 U.S. financial institution with more than $225 billion in assets and a member of the Fortune 500™. Discover more at[firstcitizens.com](http://firstcitizens.com/) .
